**The document doesn't give these numbers.** Figure 2 (right) plots TL;DR win rates against sampling temperature (p. 7), but the extracted text contains only the axes and legend, not the plotted values. So I can't report PPO's or DPO's win rate at temperature 1.0.

The text does say the following:

- **At temperature 0.0:** DPO's win rate is about 61%, and PPO's is 57%. 0.0 is also PPO's best temperature (p. 9).
- **At high temperatures:** DPO is "much more robust to the sampling temperature than PPO." PPO's performance "can degrade to that of the base GPT-J model at high temperatures" (p. 9). The Figure 2 caption makes the same point (p. 7).

Table 2 (p. 10) includes PPO at temperature 1.0 ("PPO-1"), but that is a different measurement. It compares PPO-1 head-to-head against PPO at temperature 0, not against the reference summaries. PPO-1's GPT-4 (C) win rate there is 12%, and its human win rate is 17%. It doesn't answer your question about the Figure 2 plot.
